title: Performance Demo / Regular trees and lighter shadows
goal: Enter and watch weather, clouds, wind and daylight run automatically.
changes: First-person weapons and hands now follow world sun, moon and ambient light instead of a fixed studio light. Turning changes which surfaces catch the light; the interval between sun and planet remains dark. Cached weapon rendering is retained, with lighting changes checked at 10 Hz. Planet size and environment defaults are unchanged.
controls: Enter: begin. Ctrl+F4: Weather / Daylight / Clouds / Wind controls. Selecting a weather preset pauses its automatic cycle; re-enable Cycle weather to resume. Scrub daylight to hold a time; Animate day resumes.
